commits.subject: add expo-overview skill (#107)
commits.summary: The skill now defaults to `@expo/ui` for common native controls, cautions that `List` is not virtualized, adds a `BottomSheet` example, and notes SDK 56+ Expo Go support.

commits.subject: [skills] collect eval-candidate signals via new evals feedback category (#126)
commits.summary: The skill now directs agents to load `expo-skill-feedback` and follow its eval-candidate flow after repeated failures or user takeovers, rather than reusing the standard feedback command.

commits.subject: [skills] add automated feedback submission (#112)
commits.summary: The skill adds a feedback-submission section with a command for reporting actionable errors or misleading or outdated information.

commits.subject: Organize skills with expo-* and eas-* (#98)
commits.summary: The skill description now labels expo-ui as an open-source framework and identifies the SwiftUI package as iOS-only and the Jetpack Compose package as Android-only.

commits.subject: improve expo-ui skill (#89)
commits.summary: The skill adds an allowed-tools declaration and warns that platform-specific UI imports must be isolated to their target platform, with guidance on platform-specific files, `Platform.OS` guards, and importing `Host` from the package root.

commits.subject: merge expo-ui skills (#80)
commits.summary: The commit creates the expo-ui skill with installation guidance, a decision path for universal versus platform-specific components, migration notes for community-library replacements, and reference links.
